property.name: text
property.value: C, L or Ctrl: DASH! Jump, then dash to cross wide gaps. Landing recharges your dash.

property.name: text
property.value: Hold UP as you dash to fly upward. Diagonals work too.

property.name: text
property.value: Blades at head height! Run, then press DOWN to SLIDE under. Slides knock enemies flat.

property.name: text
property.value: Cracked sandstone crumbles under a dash, a slide or a pound. Something glints inside that box...

property.name: text
property.value: The Lantern Road. Touching a blue lantern gives your dash back in mid-air.

property.name: text
property.value: In the air, press DOWN to POUND. Pounds break cracked floors and press bronze plates.

property.name: text
property.value: A pressed plate opens its portcullis.
